title: Leadville Trail 100 Run Live 2026 — official race-day results hub
publisher: Life Time Leadville Race Series (timing results hosted on the event hub)
claims: The 2026 Life Time Leadville Trail 100 Run was held August 22-23, 2026.
The live results hub lists 391 finishers, 656 overall entries, 265 DNFs, 498 male, 153 female and 5 non-binary athletes.
Adrian Macdonald (Fort Collins, CO, M30-39) won the men's race in 15:47:23.
Mckendree Hickory (Steamboat Springs, CO, F30-39) was the women's winner in 19:39:12, placing 10th overall.
Second overall was Matthew Zupan (Reno, NV) in 16:15:25; third was Tim Tollefson (Mammoth Lakes, CA) in 16:45:13.
